name: NRX PHARMACEUTICALS INC
summary: NRX PHARMACEUTICALS INC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapeutics for the treatment of central nervous system disorders, particularly those related to suicidal depression and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania, the company is developing therapies based on its proprietary NMDA-targeting platform. NRX Pharmaceuticals aims to provide innovative solutions for patients with unmet medical needs.
